title: Grilled Fish Skewers with Crunchy Slaw
description: A quick and easy recipe for grilled fish skewers served with a crunchy slaw made with norwegian ingredients.

ingredients.name: Salmon Fillets
ingredients.notes: Fresh salmon fillets for the skewers

ingredients.name: Crunchy Slaw
ingredients.notes: Shredded cabbage and carrot slaw with a crunchy texture

ingredients.name: Lemon Juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed lemon juice for marinating

ingredients.name: Skewers
ingredients.notes: Norwegian skewers for grilling the fish

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: For brushing the skewers before grilling

instructions: 1. Cut the salmon fillets into bite-sized pieces and thread onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice and olive oil. Brush the skewers with the marinade and season with salt and pepper.
3. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the fish is cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, mix together the crunchy slaw ingredients and set aside.
5. Once the skewers are cooked, serve with the crunchy slaw and a dollop of quick pickle on top.
6. Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
